stem: What causes the emperor to realize he made a mistake?

options.label: A
options.text: The mechanical nightingale puts him to sleep.

options.label: B
options.text: The mechanical nightingale can no longer make music.

options.label: C
options.text: The real nightingale leaves the palace.

options.label: D
options.text: The real nightingale grants the emperor forgiveness.
